en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing scenes related to a glassworks called Josephinenhütte. The left image depicts a carved wooden signpost with a figure of a glassblower standing on top and the word "Josephinenhütte" on a hanging sign. The upper‑right image shows the stone entrance building of the Josephinenhütte factory with a clock above the gate and workers or visitors lined up in front. The lower‑right image shows glassmakers at work inside the glassworks, blowing and shaping molten glass in a workshop.
